posts.text: Running Qwen3-Coder-Next (80B) fully offline on a 16GB Mac mini at 11.5-13.4 tok/s shows local hardware constraints are shrinking. As Gemini 4 Argon debuts in paid API tiers, a 29 GB GGUF on Hugging Face lets devs run massive models on consumer hardware. Source: Reddit & X
posts.note: X 게시글 원문. 글 속 모델 출시·순위 주장은 검증 전
